_artifact_role: REVAS independent representation of the frozen Evolve constraint and live state. pilot-01/request.json was intentionally excluded from derivation.

scope: Verify reports supported verification state; Adoption Gate owns the adoption decision.
Temporarily incomplete but still satisfiable maps to HOLD; invalid, unconfirmable, or terminally incomplete maps to REJECT.
Sensitive-category dual authorization is organizational policy layered on top of mapped framework requirements, not a direct HIPAA prescription.

constraint.description: AI-generated recommendations affecting PHI must not be adopted into the health record without explicit human authorization from a credentialed clinician with documented authority over the patient record.
constraint.scope: Any AI system output that would result in creation, modification, or deletion of protected health information in an EHR.

attestation_metadata.posture_contribution: 18% of overall AI governance posture score for healthcare domain

framework_mappings.requirement: Unique user identification and access control for PHI systems
Policies for AI risk management established and communicated
AI risk assessment — identify risks to individuals from AI system outputs

authority_requirements: Approving actor must hold a valid clinical credential recognized by the organization
Approving actor must have documented access authority for the specific patient record
Dual authorization required if patient is flagged as sensitive category (mental health, substance abuse, HIV/AIDS)

dual_authorization_layer.framework_boundary: HIPAA §164.312(a)(1) is preserved as an access-control framework mapping. The sensitive-category dual-authorization rule is preserved separately as organizational policy.

evidence_requirements: Minimum necessary standard must be satisfied — AI system must log which PHI fields were accessed to generate the recommendation
Model version, input hash, and output hash must be recorded before authorization is requested
Authorization event must be logged with actor identity, timestamp, and reason code

authority_state.primary_authority_source: EHR access control list — verified against patient record

route_and_adoption.gate_reason: Required authorization and evidence are incomplete, but the authorization window remains open and the missing conditions are still satisfiable.
route_and_adoption.condition_for_escalation: Dual authorization required if sensitive_category == true
route_and_adoption.reject_boundary: REJECT and quarantine if authority cannot be confirmed or the required evidence becomes invalid, unconfirmable, or terminally incomplete.
route_and_adoption.receipt_format: TrustLedger — SHA-256 hash of adopted state, anchored to external timestamp, linked to authorization event
route_and_adoption.rollback_trigger: If authorization is later found to be unauthorized, all downstream adopted states derived from this recommendation must be flagged for reverification

semantic_invariants: known primary authority must remain preserved when secondary authority is missing
current_state must remain timestamp-aligned with the evaluation snapshot
no adoption without complete required authority and evidence
no silent loss of provenance or state lineage
